title: Origins renamed keybinds
description: Renames origins keybinds to something more intuitive. Origins extra keybinds supported.
body:
# General info
- Renames all english origins keybinds to something more intuitive. For example:
  - Active (Primary) -> 1st ability (Primary)
  - Active (Quaternary) -> 4th ability (Quaternary)
- Only supports [Origins Extra Keybinds](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins-extra-keybinds-fabric). Other extra keybinds mods will not work.
- Also makes sure keys are sorted in the keybinds screen.
# Final notes
- Intended to be used with my other origins projects that requires [extra keybinds fabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins-extra-keybinds-fabric), while retaining the intuitive naming conventions of [extra keybinds forge](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins-extra-keybinds).
- Join the discord server to report bugs(really), suggest new features, or just hang out!.
